strict.name: strict
strict.description: Default. Model (argmax decoding) + deterministic rules; any target finding blocks.
strict.evidence: Round 2 (reports/history/ROUND2_REPORT.md): selected system r2_e3b_positive + rules v3, full pipeline on dev_v1 (56 BLOCK / 75 ALLOW): False ALLOW 0/56 (95% CI 0-6.4%), False BLOCK 27/75 (36%). Recommended default.

maximum.name: maximum
maximum.description: Higher recall at the cost of more false blocks: a token is flagged when P(not O) >= 0.05.
maximum.evidence: Round 2, same system on dev_v1: False ALLOW 0/56, False BLOCK 32/75 (43%): no leakage benefit observable on dev_v1, +5 false blocks. On report-only synthetic sets fewer leaks (format shift 45 -> 20 of 3055; long documents 2 -> 0 of 45). Optional mode for especially sensitive deployments.
